memory_candidates.insight: A one-directional lemma plus a false converse is a carried-hypothesis signal, not a derivation gap: when a plan says to DERIVE a path-level fact from a state-level regime hypothesis, check the converse direction explicitly before attempting it. Here cntAt_le_nxtAt_succ_of_idle_past (idle past => window) has a false converse, so the regime's path data had to be carried existentially over paths, in the shape an already-landed sibling condition used for the complementary regime.

Lifting a path-level Lean construction to a cell-level inclusion is a near-mechanical transcription when a sibling inclusion already exists: mem_cellAt_ladder_iff on both sides, simp [coord, hgz] for each coordinate read-off, Subtype.ext plus change on the state triple, and rw with the type-transport clause. Copying the sibling's proof shape verbatim and substituting only the regime derivation compiled on the first attempt.
